# Table styling (key/value)

Goal: make a 2-column "spec" table feel like a clean settings panel.

| Setting | Value |
|-|------|
| renderer | fallback |
| tables | tablem |
| timeout_ms | 120000 |
| justify | true |
| font | Inter |
| note | This is a longer value that should wrap nicely without the table looking cramped. |

## With empty-ish values

| Setting | Value |
|-|------|
| author | |
| date | 2026-01-11 |
| toc | false |
